en.body:
Giorgio Stefano, Tebby González & More

This edition of Mystical Sunset features a lineup of DJs who are set to soundtrack the evening at Mia Beach Club. Giorgio Stefano and Tebby González, known for their blend of melodic house and progressive, will be setting the tone. Vitto Brion & Alexia García, Kelila, and Regina are also on deck, further exploring the sounds of deep house and organic electronica that will guide dancers from sunset well into the night.

Tulum's Sunset Sessions

Mystical Sunset has become a staple in Tulum’s vibrant electronic music scene, offering an a escape where music meets the breathtaking backdrop of the Caribbean coast. Beyond just a party, it has evolved into a cultural focal point, bringing together international talent and local artists alike.

Beachfront Atmosphere

Mia Beach Club provides the perfect setting for Mystical Sunset, its open-air design seamlessly blending with the natural beauty of Tulum. The venue's architecture incorporates organic elements like thatched roofs and wooden accents, creating an intimate atmosphere that invites dancers to connect with the music and the surrounding environment. With the sand beneath your feet and the stars above, the setting enhances the overall sonic experience.

Tables & Tickets

Doors open at 5 PM, with the music continuing until 1 AM. Early bird tickets are available, starting at $450 MXN, with prices increasing as the event approaches. Table reservations are highly recommended, ensuring a prime spot to enjoy the music and artistic performances—including the fire show—that complete this edition of Mystical Sunset.
en.description: Giorgio Stefano & Tebby González plus Vitto Brion & Alexia García headline Mystical Sunset, joined by Kelila and Regina for electronic vibes.
en.name: Mystical Sunset

es.body:
Giorgio Stefano, Tebby González y más

Esta edición de Mystical Sunset cuenta con un cartel de DJs que pondrán la banda sonora a la velada en Mia Beach Club. Giorgio Stefano y Tebby González, conocidos por su mezcla de house melódico y progresivo, pondrán la nota musical. Vitto Brion & Alexia García, Kelila y Regina también estarán en la cubierta, explorando aún más los sonidos del deep house y la electrónica orgánica que guiarán a los bailarines desde el atardecer hasta bien entrada la noche.

Sesiones Sunset de Tulum

Mystical Sunset se ha convertido en un elemento básico de la vibrante escena de música electrónica de Tulum, ofreciendo una escapada en la que la música se encuentra con el impresionante telón de fondo de la costa caribeña. Más allá de una simple fiesta, se ha convertido en un centro cultural que reúne a talentos internacionales y artistas locales por igual.

Ambiente frente al mar

Mia Beach Club es el escenario perfecto para Mystical Sunset, ya que su diseño al aire libre se funde a la perfección con la belleza natural de Tulum. La arquitectura del lugar incorpora elementos orgánicos como techos de paja y detalles de madera, creando un ambiente íntimo que invita a los bailarines a conectar con la música y el entorno que les rodea. Con la arena bajo los pies y las estrellas en lo alto, el entorno realza la experiencia sonora global.

Mesas y entradas

Las puertas se abren a las 17.00 horas y la música continúa hasta la 1.00 de la madrugada. Las entradas anticipadas cuestan a partir de 450 MXN, y los precios aumentan a medida que se acerca el evento. Se recomienda reservar mesa para disfrutar de la música y los espectáculos artísticos, incluido el show de fuego, que completan esta edición de Mystical Sunset.

Ten Ibiza has become a staple in Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene, consistently showcasing both established and emerging talents. By curating lineups that blend local and international artists, Ten Ibiza contributes to the unique cultural tapestry that defines Tulum's nightlife.

Beachfront Atmosphere

Vagalume Tulum provides the perfect backdrop for Ten Ibiza's sonic explorations. The beach club's open-air setting, combined with its sophisticated design, creates an atmosphere that is both luxurious and inviting. With the sand beneath your feet and the Caribbean breeze in the air, Vagalume offers a sensory experience that enhances the music and elevates the party to new heights.

Tables & Tickets

Early bird tickets start at $605 MXN, offering an accessible entry point to this unforgettable event. Secure your tickets in advance to guarantee your spot on the dance floor, as Ten Ibiza at Vagalume is sure to be a highlight of Tulum's December calendar.

Los DJs crearán una banda sonora perfecta para bailar bajo las estrellas, en la que se mezclarán las vibraciones baleares y el sonido característico de la playa de Tulum.

El ritual semanal de Tulum

Ten Ibiza se ha convertido en un elemento básico de la vibrante escena de la música electrónica de Tulum, presentando constantemente tanto a talentos consagrados como emergentes. La serie es conocida por su dedicación a la música house de calidad y su capacidad para crear una experiencia de inmersión para los amantes de la música. en.body:
The Night Ahead

Gala Ibiza at Vagalume presents a night of carefully curated sounds, headlined by Detroit house and techno pioneer Moodymann, whose raw, soulful selections are legendary. Iban Mendoza, the driving force behind Gala, delivers a live set promising a deep dive into his signature sound. Ananta & Sidartha Siliceo (Live) open the evening, setting the stage with an organic live performance, ensuring a smooth transition into the night’s more intense rhythms.

A Surrealist Sonic Journey

Gala Ibiza aims to deliver an event that transcends the typical beach party, focusing on a surrealist atmosphere and cutting-edge musical curation. This second edition builds upon the foundation laid by the first, promising a more refined and immersive experience. The series represents a commitment to showcasing artists who push boundaries within the house and deep house spectrum, offering a counterpoint to more mainstream offerings in Tulum.

Beachfront Rhythms

Vagalume Tulum's beachfront location creates an unparalleled atmosphere for Gala Ibiza. The venue’s design allows for an intimate connection between the artists and the crowd, with the sound of the waves providing a natural backdrop. The open-air setting and Tulum’s balmy evening air combine to heighten the impact of the music, creating a multi-sensory experience.

Secure Your Spot

Doors open at 7:00 PM, with the event running until 1:00 AM. Early bird tickets start at $550 MXN, with prices increasing to $1,540 MXN for final release. Given the popularity of Vagalume and the draw of this lineup, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended to avoid disappointment.
en.description: Moodymann headlines Gala Ibiza with raw house and techno. Iban Mendoza brings a live set, plus Ananta & Sidartha Siliceo's organic sounds.
en.name: Gala Ibiza

es.body:
La noche que viene

Gala Ibiza en Vagalume presenta una noche de sonidos cuidadosamente seleccionados, encabezados por el pionero del house y techno de Detroit Moodymann, cuyas selecciones crudas y conmovedoras son legendarias. Iban Mendoza, la fuerza impulsora de Gala, ofrecerá un set en directo que promete una inmersión profunda en su sonido característico. Ananta & Sidartha Siliceo (Live) abren la velada, preparando el escenario con una actuación orgánica en directo, asegurando una transición suave hacia los ritmos más intensos de la noche.

Un viaje sonoro surrealista

Gala Ibiza pretende ofrecer un evento que trascienda la típica fiesta en la playa, centrándose en una atmósfera surrealista y una selección musical de vanguardia. Esta segunda edición se basa en los cimientos establecidos por la primera, prometiendo una experiencia más refinada y envolvente. La serie representa un compromiso con la presentación de artistas que amplían los límites dentro del espectro del house y el deep house, ofreciendo un contrapunto a las ofertas más convencionales de Tulum.

Ritmos frente al mar

La ubicación frente al mar de Vagalume Tulum crea un ambiente incomparable para Gala Ibiza. El diseño del lugar permite una conexión íntima entre los artistas y el público, con el sonido de las olas como telón de fondo natural. El entorno al aire libre y el aire templado de la noche de Tulum se combinan para aumentar el impacto de la música, creando una experiencia multisensorial.

Reserva tu plaza

Las puertas se abren a las 7:00 PM, y el evento durará hasta la 1:00 AM. Los boletos anticipados cuestan desde $550 MXN, con precios que aumentan a $1,540 MXN para el lanzamiento final. Dada la popularidad de Vagalume y la atracción de esta alineación, es altamente recomendable asegurar boletos con anticipación para evitar decepciones.
es.description: Moodymann encabeza Gala Ibiza con house crudo y techno. Iban Mendoza trae un set en directo, además de los sonidos orgánicos de Ananta & Sidartha Siliceo.

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Ten Ibiza at Vagalume Tulum presents a carefully curated lineup this December, embarking on "A Journey into House Music." ORIOL CALVO, INVITES, POMBOKLAP, and RENÊ each contribute their distinct perspectives to the night, promising a sonic exploration rooted in house music's diverse subgenres. This edition offers a blend of established and emerging talents, reflecting Ibiza's enduring influence on global house music culture.

Ibiza's Tulum Takeover

Ten Ibiza brings a slice of the White Isle's vibrant party scene to the shores of Tulum. While details about the collective behind Ten Ibiza are scarce, their events consistently showcase a commitment to quality house music. The series offers a taste of Ibiza's hedonistic spirit, transported to the unique setting of the Mexican Caribbean.

Beachfront House Music

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the heart of the hotel zone, provides the ideal backdrop for Ten Ibiza's sonic journey. The venue's beachfront location and premium beach club atmosphere create a seamless transition from daytime relaxation to nighttime revelry. Expect a sand-between-your-toes experience as house rhythms pulsate beneath the stars.

Tables & Tickets

Doors open at 7 PM, and the sounds continue until 1 AM. Early bird tickets are available for $605 MXN, offering a more affordable entry to this premium event. Secure your tickets in advance to guarantee access to this showcase of house music at Vagalume Tulum.
en.description: Oriol Calvo, Pomboklap, and Renê guide Ten Ibiza through a house music journey with vibrant energy and irresistible rhythms.
en.name: Ten Ibiza

es.body:
La noche que viene

Ten Ibiza en Vagalume Tulum presenta un cartel cuidadosamente comisariado este diciembre, embarcándose en "Un viaje a la música House" ORIOL CALVO, INVITES, POMBOKLAP, y RENÊ aportan cada uno sus distintas perspectivas a la noche, prometiendo una exploración sonora arraigada en los diversos subgéneros de la música house. Esta edición ofrece una mezcla de talentos consagrados y emergentes, reflejo de la perdurable influencia de Ibiza en la cultura mundial de la música house.

Ibiza's Tulum Takeover

Ten Ibiza lleva un trozo de la vibrante escena festiva de la Isla Blanca a las costas de Tulum. Aunque no se conocen muchos detalles sobre el colectivo que está detrás de Ten Ibiza, sus eventos demuestran un compromiso constante con la música house de calidad. La serie ofrece una muestra del espíritu hedonista de Ibiza, transportado al entorno único del Caribe mexicano.

Música house frente al mar

Vagalume Tulum, situado en el corazón de la zona hotelera, ofrece el telón de fondo ideal para el viaje sonoro de Ten Ibiza. Su ubicación frente a la playa y su ambiente de club de playa de primera crean una transición perfecta de la relajación diurna a la juerga nocturna. Disfruta de la arena entre los dedos de los pies mientras los ritmos house laten bajo las estrellas.

Mesas y entradas

Las puertas se abren a las 19:00 y el sonido continúa hasta la 1:00 de la madrugada. Los boletos anticipados están disponibles por $605 MXN, ofreciendo una entrada más accesible a este evento premium. Asegura tus boletos con anticipación para garantizar el acceso a este escaparate de la música house en Vagalume Tulum.

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Steve Lawler and Jesse Zotti commandeer the decks for this edition of Pendulum at Vagalume, promising a night steeped in underground house and techno. Steve Lawler, a name synonymous with boundary-pushing sets, brings his signature sound, a blend of genres that keeps the dance floor moving. Jesse Zotti adds his distinct flavor to the mix, complementing Lawler's energy with his own take on contemporary electronic rhythms.

From Residency to Revival

Pendulum's return to Vagalume follows a highly acclaimed residency earlier in 2025, solidifying its place as a key event in Tulum's electronic music calendar. The series represents a curated experience, focusing on established names and rising talents within the house and techno scenes. Pendulum's commitment to delivering a quality musical experience has cultivated a dedicated following within Tulum and beyond.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum, nestled in the Hotel Zone, transforms from a serene beach club by day to a vibrant nightlife destination as the sun sets. The open-air venue, known for its premium atmosphere, allows the rhythms of Pendulum to merge seamlessly with the natural surroundings. Dancing barefoot on the sand, surrounded by the jungle's edge, creates a uniquely Tulum experience.

Secure Your Spot

Doors open at 7:00 PM and the party continues until 1:00 AM, with peak hours expected to be after 9 PM. Early bird tickets are available starting at $605 MXN, with prices increasing as the event date approaches. Adhering to the Tulum-style dress code is encouraged, and advance ticket purchase is recommended to guarantee entry to this sought-after event.
en.description: Steve Lawler & Jesse Zotti ignite Pendulum with signature underground sounds. Expect tribal grooves & energetic rhythms in Tulum's mystic atmosphere.

es.body:
La noche que viene

Steve Lawler y Jesse Zotti tomarán los platos en esta edición de Pendulum en Vagalume, prometiendo una noche impregnada de house y techno underground. Steve Lawler, un nombre sinónimo de sets que traspasan fronteras, aporta su sonido característico, una mezcla de géneros que mantiene la pista de baile en movimiento. Jesse Zotti añade su toque personal a la mezcla, complementando la energía de Lawler con su propia visión de los ritmos electrónicos contemporáneos.

De la residencia al revival

El regreso de Pendulum a Vagalume se produce después de una aclamada residencia a principios de 2025, consolidando su lugar como un evento clave en el calendario de música electrónica de Tulum. La serie representa una experiencia comisariada, centrada en nombres establecidos y talentos emergentes dentro de las escenas house y techno. El compromiso de Pendulum para ofrecer una experiencia musical de calidad ha cultivado un seguimiento dedicado dentro de Tulum y más allá.

Baile en la arena

Vagalume Tulum, situado en la Zona Hotelera, se transforma de un sereno club de playa durante el día a un vibrante destino nocturno cuando se pone el sol. El local al aire libre, conocido por su ambiente de primera, permite que los ritmos de Péndulo se fundan a la perfección con el entorno natural. Bailar descalzo sobre la arena, rodeado por el borde de la selva, crea una experiencia única en Tulum.

Asegura tu plaza

Las puertas se abren a las 19:00 y la fiesta continúa hasta la 1:00. Se espera que las horas punta sean a partir de las 21:00. Los boletos anticipados están disponibles a partir de $605 MXN, con precios que aumentan a medida que se acerca la fecha del evento. Se recomienda seguir el código de vestimenta de Tulum y comprar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a este codiciado evento.
es.description: Steve Lawler y Jesse Zotti encienden Pendulum con sus sonidos underground característicos. Disfruta de grooves tribales y ritmos enérgicos en la atmósfera mística de Tulum.

en.body:
Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer & Andru at The New Moon

This edition of The New Moon at Papaya Playa Project features a lineup dedicated to house and melodic sounds, bringing together Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer, and Andru. Portable, known for his deep and rhythmic productions, sets a foundational tone, while Tod Louie and Karl Fraunhofer contribute their distinct approaches to electronic music. Andru completes the bill, ensuring a carefully curated evening designed for the beachfront setting. The selection of these artists aims to create a specific atmosphere for dancing on the Caribbean shore.

Papaya Playa Project's Collaborative Series

Papaya Playa Project, a recognized name in Tulum's hospitality and events scene, presents "The New Moon" in collaboration with Det Gode Selskab. PPP has a history of hosting significant events, including their "Gratitude Season" which featured artists like Monolink and Dixon, and their signature "Full Moon Party" series. This collaboration with Det Gode Selskab underscores PPP's commitment to curating diverse musical experiences within its eco-conscious sanctuary, bringing together different collectives to shape unique nights for the community.

Tulum's Jungle-Meets-Ocean Sanctuary

Papaya Playa Project offers a distinctive venue experience, blending Tulum's natural beauty with a focus on sustainability. Situated along a long stretch of coastline, the event unfolds in a jungle-meets-ocean sanctuary where guests can dance barefoot on pristine Caribbean sand. The setting is designed to harmonize with nature, providing an intimate environment where the ocean breeze carries the music through the palms, enhancing the connection between sound, community, and the natural surroundings.

Entry & Experience Details

Doors for The New Moon open at 6:30 PM, with general admission starting at 7:00 PM, and last entry permitted at 12:50 AM. Attendees can choose between a general admission ticket for the musical journey or enhance their evening with a Mayan Dinner Experience or VIP table packages, which include bottle service or credit for food and drinks. Capacity for the event is limited to maintain the intimacy and energy of the dance floor, making early ticket acquisition advisable. Dress code for the evening is casual, with a dinner-casual option for those opting for the culinary experience.
en.description: Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer, and Andru bring house and melodic sounds to Ppp • the New Moon • Music by Ppp x Det Gode Selskab at Papaya Playa
en.name: The New Moon

es.body:
La noche que viene

Papaya Playa Project da la bienvenida a Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer y Andru para esta edición especial de Ppp x Det Gode Selskab. Te espera un viaje a través de paisajes sonoros que mezclan house y ritmos melódicos, perfectamente adecuados para la costa de Tulum. Portable, conocido por su sonido profundamente texturizado y emotivo, marca el tono, mientras que la energía contagiosa de Tod Louie mantiene la pista de baile en movimiento. Karl Fraunhofer y Andru completan el cartel, garantizando una noche de refinadas selecciones y cálidas líneas de bajo.

Ritual semanal de Tulum

Ppp x Det Gode Selskab se ha convertido en un elemento básico en la vibrante escena de la música electrónica de Tulum, ofreciendo una experiencia cuidadosamente comisariada que mezcla el talento internacional con el ambiente único de la costa caribeña. Esta colaboración entre Papaya Playa Project y Det Gode Selskab asegura una noche centrada en la exploración sónica y la conexión con la comunidad, solidificando su lugar como un evento imprescindible para locales y visitantes por igual. El ciclo da prioridad a la música de calidad y a una pista de baile íntima, fomentando un sentimiento de unidad entre los asistentes.

Ambiente frente al mar

Papaya Playa Project ofrece el escenario perfecto para esta edición de Ppp x Det Gode Selskab, transformando su santuario entre la selva y el océano en un paraíso para los amantes de la música. El diseño al aire libre del lugar permite que la música fluya a la perfección con la brisa marina, mientras que el suelo de arena anima a bailar descalzo bajo las estrellas. La acústica natural del espacio realza los ritmos profundos y las cálidas líneas de bajo, creando una experiencia sonora realmente envolvente.

Asegure su plaza

Esta noche especial frente al mar comienza a las 3 PM el 20 de diciembre, prometiendo horas de house cuidadosamente curado y sonidos melódicos. Los boletos cuestan a partir de $1,100 MXN, y la capacidad es limitada para preservar la intimidad y la energía de la pista de baile. Dada la popularidad tanto de Papaya Playa Project como de la serie Ppp x Det Gode Selskab, es muy recomendable asegurar tus boletos con anticipación.

The Night Ahead

Although the specific lineup for this edition of Elysium remains under wraps, the return of Afshin Momadi, fresh from a successful summer season and a Beatport-charting single, sets the tone for a night steeped in melodic house and progressive grooves. Momadi's presence guarantees a journey through soundscapes designed for expansive dance floors, bringing a taste of Ibiza and European festival energy to the heart of Tulum. Expect a carefully curated selection of supporting talent to complement Momadi's signature style.

From Jungle Parties to Institution

Elysium's Tulum residency marks a significant chapter for the event series, solidifying its reputation as a purveyor of high-quality electronic music experiences. After making waves across Europe, the move to the Mexican jungle showcases Elysium's commitment to curating unique atmospheres in iconic locations. The series' focus on blending international talent with the natural beauty of Tulum has resonated with discerning music lovers, establishing Elysium as a must-attend event within the region's thriving scene.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum's beachfront setting provides the perfect backdrop for Elysium's utopian vision. The open-air venue, with its sand floor and unobstructed views of the Caribbean Sea, creates an intimate and immersive environment for dancers. The design of the space encourages a connection between the music, the natural surroundings, and the energy of the crowd, enhancing the overall experience.

Arrive Before Midnight

Elysium at Vagalume Tulum begins at 7:00 PM and continues until 1:00 AM, with peak hours expected after 9:00 PM. Early bird tickets start at $605 MXN, with prices increasing as the event approaches. Given the popularity of both Elysium and Vagalume, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended.
en.description: Elysium welcomes Afshin Momadi to the jungle! Experience his signature sound after massive plays at Tomorrowland, Zamna, and Ushuaia Ibiza.
en.name: Elysium

es.body:
La noche que se avecina

Aunque el line-up específico de esta edición de Elysium permanece en secreto, el regreso de Afshin Momadi, recién salido de una exitosa temporada de verano y con un single de éxito en Beatport, marca el tono de una noche impregnada de house melódico y grooves progresivos. La presencia de Momadi garantiza un viaje a través de paisajes sonoros diseñados para amplias pistas de baile, trayendo un sabor de Ibiza y la energía de los festivales europeos al corazón de Tulum. Se espera una cuidada selección de talentos para complementar el estilo característico de Momadi.

De las fiestas en la jungla a la institución

La residencia de Elysium en Tulum marca un capítulo importante para la serie de eventos, consolidando su reputación como proveedor de experiencias de música electrónica de alta calidad. Tras causar sensación en Europa, el traslado a la jungla mexicana demuestra el compromiso de Elysium con la creación de atmósferas únicas en lugares emblemáticos. El enfoque de la serie en la mezcla de talento internacional con la belleza natural de Tulum ha resonado entre los amantes de la música más exigentes, estableciendo a Elysium como un evento imprescindible dentro de la próspera escena de la región.

Baile en la arena

El entorno de Vagalume Tulum, en primera línea de playa, es el telón de fondo perfecto para la visión utópica de Elysium. El espacio al aire libre, con su suelo de arena y vistas despejadas al mar Caribe, crea un ambiente íntimo y envolvente para los bailarines. El diseño del espacio fomenta la conexión entre la música, el entorno natural y la energía del público, mejorando la experiencia global.

Llegar antes de medianoche

Elysium en Vagalume Tulum comienza a las 7:00 PM y continúa hasta la 1:00 AM, con horas pico esperadas después de las 9:00 PM. Los boletos anticipados comienzan en $605 MXN, con precios que aumentan a medida que se acerca el evento. Dada la popularidad tanto de Elysium como de Vagalume, es muy recomendable conseguir las entradas con antelación.

en.body:
Joris Voorn & Nic Fanciulli Headline Disorder

This edition of Disorder showcases a meeting of minds, as Joris Voorn and Nic Fanciulli bring their distinct takes on electronic music to Vagalume. Voorn's precision-driven melodic techno, honed on labels like Green and Cocoon, meets Fanciulli's groove-centric house and techno, a sound he has championed on Saved Records for years. This session promises a sophisticated exploration of the deeper shades of house and techno, supported by Sebastian Konrad, Miul, and Negrinm, each adding their own local flavor to the night.

Tulum's Weekly Ritual

Disorder has become a fixture in Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene, known for curating lineups that blend international headliners with local talent. The series has carved out a niche for itself by consistently delivering high-quality music experiences, creating a space for dedicated electronic music fans to connect and dance. Disorder's commitment to showcasing both established and emerging artists has solidified its position as a key player in Tulum's nightlife.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum provides the perfect backdrop for Disorder's immersive soundscapes. The beachfront palapa creates an intimate and energetic atmosphere, where the sounds of rolling basslines and polyrhythmic percussion resonate with the natural acoustics of the space. The sand floor adds a tactile connection to the earth, enhancing the overall sensory experience and fostering a sense of community among the dancers.

Tables & Tickets

Doors open at 1:00 PM, with peak hours expected later in the evening. The dress code is Tulum style, encouraging guests to embrace the bohemian spirit of the venue. Tickets start at $880 MXN, and with a lineup this strong, early purchase is highly recommended to secure your spot on the dancefloor.

en.body:
Serge Devant, Lum & Julioo in Tulum

This edition of Definition showcases a lineup featuring Serge Devant, Lum, and Julioo, bringing a distinct blend of electronic music to Vagalume. Serge Devant headlines the session, contributing to the event's stated aim of uniting Los Angeles' underground culture with Tulum's internationally recognized scene. Lum and Julioo complete the roster, each adding to the curated experience designed for electronic music enthusiasts seeking an evening of elevated energy and exceptional production under the Tulum night sky.

Definition's Cross-Cultural Bridge

Definition functions as a party series that actively bridges distinct electronic music cultures, specifically connecting the underground scene of Los Angeles with Tulum's world-famous nightlife. The series is built on a concept of "global fusion of sound and style," bringing a curated experience that emphasizes high-quality production and a vibrant atmosphere. Definition aims to create a cohesive event identity that resonates with discerning music lovers across these two influential locations.

Vagalume's Beachfront Transformation

The event takes place at Vagalume Tulum, a premium beach club located within Tulum's vibrant Hotel Zone. Vagalume is known for its ability to transform from a serene daytime setting into an energetic nighttime destination, offering a high-end atmosphere with stunning beachfront views of the Caribbean Sea. After 7 PM, the venue becomes a lively hub, providing an ideal backdrop for electronic music events and attracting a diverse mix of international and local attendees.

Event Details and Entry

Entry for Definition begins at $605 MXN for early bird tickets, with prices escalating to $880 MXN for first release and $1,210 MXN for second release. The event is scheduled from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, inviting guests to immerse themselves in the experience. A "Tulum Style" dress code is suggested for attendees, and VIP tables with bottle service are available for those seeking an enhanced experience, with inquiries directed via WhatsApp.
en.description: Serge Devant headlines Definition's electronic music session at Vagalume, joined by LUM and JULIOO.

es.body:
Serge Devant, Lum y Julioo en Tulum

Esta edición de Definition presenta un cartel con Serge Devant, Lum y Julioo, que aportan una mezcla distintiva de música electrónica a Vagalume. Serge Devant encabeza la sesión, contribuyendo al objetivo declarado del evento de unir la cultura underground de Los Ángeles con la escena internacionalmente reconocida de Tulum. Lum y Julioo completan la lista, cada uno añadiendo a la experiencia comisariada diseñada para los entusiastas de la música electrónica que buscan una noche de energía elevada y producción excepcional bajo el cielo nocturno de Tulum.

El puente intercultural de Definition

Definition funciona como una serie de fiestas que tiende puentes entre distintas culturas de la música electrónica, conectando específicamente la escena underground de Los Ángeles con la mundialmente famosa vida nocturna de Tulum. La serie se basa en un concepto de "fusión global de sonido y estilo", aportando una experiencia comisariada que hace hincapié en la producción de alta calidad y un ambiente vibrante. Definition pretende crear una identidad de evento cohesiva que resuene entre los amantes de la música más exigentes en estos dos lugares tan influyentes.

Transformación de Vagalume frente al mar

El evento tiene lugar en Vagalume Tulum, un club de playa de primera categoría situado en la vibrante Zona Hotelera de Tulum. Vagalume es conocido por su capacidad para transformarse de un entorno diurno sereno en un destino nocturno lleno de energía, ofreciendo un ambiente de alta gama con impresionantes vistas frente al mar Caribe. A partir de las 19.00 horas, el lugar se convierte en un animado centro, que ofrece un telón de fondo ideal para eventos de música electrónica y atrae a una variada mezcla de asistentes internacionales y locales.

Detalles del evento y entrada

La entrada para Definition comienza en $605 MXN para los boletos anticipados, con precios que escalan a $880 MXN para el primer lanzamiento y $1,210 MXN para el segundo lanzamiento. El evento está programado de 7:00 PM a 1:00 AM, invitando a los invitados a sumergirse en la experiencia. Se sugiere un código de vestimenta "Tulum Style" para los asistentes, y las mesas VIP con servicio de botella están disponibles para aquellos que buscan una experiencia mejorada, con consultas dirigidas a través de WhatsApp.

en.body:
Cloonee

Hailing from the UK, Cloonee has rapidly established himself as a prominent figure within the global tech house scene since his breakthrough year in 2019. Known for his driving, percussive sound, he quickly garnered attention, culminating in his recognition as Beatport’s 8th best-selling tech house artist that year. His career trajectory has been marked by consistent releases on respected international imprints such as Solardo's Sola, Elrow Music, and Big Beat Records, solidifying his position as a producer with a distinct, dancefloor-focused signature.

Four-to-the-Floor Precision

Cloonee's musical style navigates the energetic intersections of tech house, house, and Latin house, characterized by robust four-to-the-floor kicks, infectious basslines, and cleverly sampled vocal hooks. His production techniques prioritize groove and impact, designed to ignite club environments. Notable tracks like "Stephanie," "Sippin' Yak," and "Mi Amor" exemplify his sound, while his 2019 Beatport Tech House #1 "Be Good To Me" showcased his early chart success. With a substantial following of 233,558 Spotify followers, his recent 2025 singles, "Vamos A La Playa," "Will We Ever Wake Up," and "Not Gonna Be Your Boo" (featuring Robin S), continue to explore his signature percussive drive.

Sunset Sessions at Bagatelle Tulum

This performance at Bagatelle Tulum's signature Sunset Sessions promises an afternoon of cutting-edge house beats set against the stunning Caribbean coastline. Cloonee's high-energy tech house sound is perfectly complemented by Bagatelle's sophisticated beach club atmosphere, which blends French Riviera elegance with Tulum's natural magic. The venue's energetic and stylish setting, known for its lively music and vibrant seaside ambiance, provides an ideal backdrop for Cloonee's percussive and groove-laden selections, ensuring a dynamic experience as the sun descends.

Securing Your Bagatelle Access

Doors for this anticipated opening of the 2026 season at Bagatelle Tulum open at 4:00 pm. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to a sophisticated atmosphere where Cloonee's sound will define the essence of Tulum's world-class music culture. Guests are encouraged to adhere to a "Fresh, chic, and effortlessly elegant" dress code, fitting for Tulum's iconic aesthetic. Advanced purchase is highly recommended to secure your spot at this exclusive event.

es.body:
Cloonee

Procedente del Reino Unido, Cloonee se ha establecido rápidamente como una figura prominente dentro de la escena tech house global desde su año de irrupción en 2019. Conocido por su sonido impulsor y percusivo, rápidamente atrajo la atención, culminando con su reconocimiento como el octavo artista tech house más vendido de Beatport ese año. La trayectoria de su carrera ha estado marcada por lanzamientos consistentes en sellos internacionales respetados como Solardo's Sola, Elrow Music y Big Beat Records, solidificando su posición como productor con una firma distintiva y centrada en la pista de baile.

Precisión a cuatro manos

El estilo musical de Cloonee navega por las enérgicas intersecciones del tech house, el house y el latin house, caracterizado por unos potentes golpes de pedal, unas líneas de bajo contagiosas y unos ganchos vocales inteligentemente muestreados. Sus técnicas de producción priorizan el groove y el impacto, diseñadas para encender los ambientes de club. Temas notables como "Stephanie", "Sippin' Yak" y "Mi Amor" ejemplifican su sonido, mientras que su número 1 de Beatport Tech House en 2019 "Be Good To Me" mostró su temprano éxito en las listas. Con un seguimiento sustancial de 233,558 seguidores de Spotify, sus recientes 2025 singles, "Vamos A La Playa", "Will We Ever Wake Up" y "Not Gonna Be Your Boo" (con Robin S), continúan explorando su impulso percusivo característico.

Sesiones al atardecer en Bagatelle Tulum

Esta actuación en las Sunset Sessions de Bagatelle Tulum promete una tarde de ritmos house de vanguardia frente a la impresionante costa caribeña. El enérgico sonido tech house de Cloonee se complementa a la perfección con el sofisticado ambiente de club de playa de Bagatelle, que combina la elegancia de la Riviera Francesa con la magia natural de Tulum. El ambiente enérgico y elegante del lugar, conocido por su música animada y su vibrante ambiente costero, proporciona un telón de fondo ideal para las selecciones percusivas y cargadas de groove de Cloonee, garantizando una experiencia dinámica mientras desciende el sol.

Cómo asegurarse el acceso a Bagatelle

Las puertas para esta anticipada apertura de la temporada 2026 en Bagatelle Tulum abren a las 4:00 pm. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN, ofreciendo acceso a una atmósfera sofisticada donde el sonido de Cloonee definirá la esencia de la cultura musical de clase mundial de Tulum. Se anima a los invitados a adherirse a un código de vestimenta "fresco, chic y elegante sin esfuerzo", acorde con la estética icónica de Tulum. La compra anticipada es muy recomendable para asegurar su lugar en este evento exclusivo.

en.body:
CamelPhat

Liverpool's multi-platinum DJ and production duo, Dave Whelan and Mike Di Scala, known as CamelPhat, have solidified their position at the forefront of global electronic music since their breakthrough hit "Cola" in 2017. The Grammy and Ivor Novello-nominated pair are celebrated for their evolving sound that navigates melodic techno, house, and progressive house territories. Their consistent output and high-charting releases have established them as one of Beatport's biggest-selling artists, maintaining a significant presence on the international club and festival circuit.

Four-to-the-Floor Evolution

CamelPhat's musical style is characterized by driving four-to-the-floor rhythms, deep basslines, and intricate melodic structures that build tension and release on the dancefloor. Their discography showcases a refined production approach, moving from the tech house sensibilities of early tracks like "Cola" to the more expansive, emotive sound explored on albums such as 2023's "Spiritual Milk" and 2022's "Dark Matter." With popular tracks like "Breathe" and "Save Me" contributing to their 530,828 Spotify followers, the duo consistently delivers productions that resonate across various electronic music subgenres.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an energetic late-night set, with CamelPhat expected to deliver their signature blend of melodic techno and progressive house. The state-of-the-art sound system and production at Bonbonniere are ideally suited to amplify their intricate sound design and powerful basslines, creating an immersive experience for attendees. As Tulum's premier nightclub, Bonbonniere's lively dance floor and luxurious ambiance, complete with a retractable roof, will provide a sophisticated yet high-energy backdrop for the duo's extended set.

Entry & Dress Code

CamelPhat will take the decks on Saturday, January 3rd, with doors opening at 10 pm for a night extending till late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to Bonbonniere's exclusive nightlife experience. A formal dress code is strictly enforced to maintain the venue's sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire, including swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts, is not permitted.

es.body:
CamelPhat

El dúo multiplatino de DJ y productores de Liverpool, Dave Whelan y Mike Di Scala, conocidos como CamelPhat, han consolidado su posición a la vanguardia de la música electrónica mundial desde su éxito rompedor "Cola" en 2017. La pareja nominada al Grammy y al Ivor Novello es célebre por su sonido en evolución que navega por los territorios del techno melódico, el house y el progressive house. El estilo musical de CamelPhat se caracteriza por sus ritmos four-to-the-floor, profundas líneas de bajo e intrincadas estructuras melódicas que crean tensión y liberación en la pista de baile. Su discografía muestra un enfoque de producción refinado, pasando de la sensibilidad tech house de los primeros temas como "Cola" al sonido más expansivo y emotivo explorado en álbumes como "Spiritual Milk" de 2023 y "Dark Matter" de 2022 Con temas populares como "Breathe" y "Save Me" que contribuyen a sus 530.828 seguidores en Spotify, el dúo ofrece constantemente producciones que resuenan en varios subgéneros de la música electrónica.

en.body:
Colyn: Melodic Techno's Global Reference

Colyn stands as a prominent figure in the global melodic techno landscape, recognized for crafting intricate soundscapes that blend driving rhythms with evocative melodies. Hailing from a scene that values emotional depth and progressive sound design, Colyn has established a reputation for sets that are both expansive and deeply engaging. As a "global reference" in the genre, Colyn's work is synonymous with the sophisticated, often cinematic, evolution of electronic music, appealing to a discerning audience that seeks both energy and narrative within the dancefloor experience.

Constructing Melodic Narratives

Colyn's musical style navigates the nuanced territories of melodic techno, characterized by its emphasis on rich harmonic progressions layered over robust four-to-the-floor foundations. Production techniques often involve shimmering arpeggios, atmospheric pads, and precisely engineered percussion, creating a sound that is both powerful and ethereal. While specific recent releases for this melodic techno artist are not detailed, the genre itself typically explores themes of introspection and euphoria, building tension and release through carefully orchestrated sonic elements.

An Intense Evening at Vagalume

This performance promises an intense, aesthetic, and vibrant experience at Vagalume, Tulum’s iconic beach club. Colyn's set is expected to guide attendees through a journey of evolving melodic techno, likely commencing with deeper, more atmospheric textures before building into driving, peak-time rhythms. Supporting acts VITE + MIGANOVA RDJ, LUNA & LENTHE, BILAL SANTIAGO B2B BELEBN, and LOEN will set the stage, complementing Colyn's sound with their own contributions to the electronic music spectrum. Vagalume's energetic beach club setting and premium atmosphere, known for its transformation from daytime serenity to nighttime vibrancy, will provide an ideal backdrop for Colyn's expansive sound.

Reservations & Entry

Given Vagalume's status as Tulum's most popular beach club and its reputation for lively events featuring international DJs, reservations are highly recommended to secure entry and ensure participation in this collaboration between Sinner and GLITCH404.

en.body:
DJ Tennis: Life and Death Visionary

Manfredi Romano, universally known as DJ Tennis, is an Italian DJ, producer, and the visionary behind the influential Life and Death imprint. Originating from a background in punk rock and a career as a professional chef, Romano transitioned to electronic music, quickly establishing himself as a pivotal figure in the global melodic house and psychedelic techno scene. His label, Life and Death, has been instrumental in cultivating a distinct sound, fostering artists who blend intricate melodies with deep, often hypnotic rhythms. DJ Tennis is renowned for his extended, narrative-driven sets, which have graced major international stages from Circoloco in Ibiza to The BPM Festival, solidifying his reputation as a selector with a profound understanding of sonic storytelling.

Eclectic Melodic Journeys

DJ Tennis's musical style navigates a sophisticated and expansive spectrum, characterized by deep, emotive melodies, intricate percussive layers, and a subtle psychedelic edge. He skillfully traverses subgenres ranging from progressive house and cosmic disco to more driving melodic techno, frequently incorporating analog textures, unexpected vocal samples, and live instrumentation into his productions and DJ sets. While specific 2025 releases for DJ Tennis are not detailed, his extensive discography on Life and Death, including seminal tracks like "Divisions (feat. Fink)" and "Chirality," consistently showcases his ability to craft tracks that are both introspective and profoundly effective on the dancefloor. His performances are celebrated for their gradual, immersive build, evolving from atmospheric, sun-drenched openers to more intense, yet always melodically rich, peaks.

Vagalume Sessions: A Tulum Soundscape

This Vagalume Sessions event promises an immersive sonic experience, with DJ Tennis at the helm, expected to deliver an extended journey that will transition seamlessly from the afternoon's deep, organic grooves into more driving melodic techno as the Tulum night unfolds. He will be joined by Eagles & Butterflies and Facundo Mohrr, two artists whose contributions to contemporary melodic electronic music perfectly complement Tennis's sound, ensuring a cohesive and evolving sonic narrative throughout the event. Vagalume Tulum's unique beachfront setting, known for its transition from daytime serenity to nighttime vibrancy, along with its exceptional acoustics and stunning Caribbean views, provides an ideal backdrop for DJ Tennis's ability to craft deeply immersive soundscapes. The lineup is further enriched by local talents Renê, Kevin Ganora, JDMaya, and Monqalamari, bringing an authentic and refined Tulum perspective to the night.

Tickets & Event Logistics

The Vagalume Sessions event is scheduled from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering a full twelve-hour electronic music experience. Early Bird Tickets are available starting at $880 MXN, with prices increasing for subsequent releases. Given Vagalume Tulum's status as a premier beach club and the high caliber of the international lineup, advanced ticket purchase is strongly recommended to secure entry. For those seeking an elevated experience, VIP tables with bottle service are available; inquiries can be made via WhatsApp to +52 984 130 1037.

en.body:
Paco Osuna: Barcelona's Techno Architect

Hailing from Barcelona, Spain, Paco Osuna has been a formidable presence in electronic music since he began DJing in 1994, establishing himself as one of Spain's most respected selectors. His career is defined by a relentless pursuit of driving tech house and minimal techno, a sound he has honed through extensive global touring and a long-standing residency at Ibiza's iconic Amnesia club. Osuna's discography reflects his commitment to the underground, with releases on influential labels such as Plus 8, Shake Records, and Noise Music, solidifying his position as a purveyor of precise, rhythmic club music.

Minimal Techno & Tech House Dynamics

Osuna's musical style navigates the intricate landscapes of minimal techno and tech house, characterized by tightly wound grooves, hypnotic loops, and a focus on percussive precision. His production work, including albums like "Long Play" (2014), "Lemon Juice" (2009), and "Orbeat" (2008), showcases his ability to construct intricate sonic narratives. Beyond his original productions, Osuna is known for impactful remixes such as "Wavy Distance - Paco Osuna Remix" and "Un Poquito - Paco Osuna Remix," which frequently feature in DJ sets worldwide. With over 103,003 Spotify followers, his influence extends across a dedicated global audience.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an extended journey through Paco Osuna's signature sound, commencing at 10 PM and continuing "till late." Attendees can anticipate a meticulously crafted set, evolving from deep, rolling tech house into more driving minimal techno as the night progresses. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and retractable roof, which offers views of the starlit sky, provide an ideal backdrop for Osuna's intricate productions, enhancing the immersive quality of his rhythmic explorations. As Tulum's premier late-night destination, Bonbonniere's energetic dance floor and luxurious ambiance are perfectly suited for an artist of Osuna's caliber.

Entry & Dress Code at Bonbonniere

Entry for Paco Osuna's performance on Monday, January 12th, 2026, begins at 10 PM. Tickets are priced starting at $1,100 MXN. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to ensure a sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire including swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted. Given Osuna's reputation and Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot in Tulum's hotel zone, advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended.

Known for blurring genre lines, Lawler's sets are characterized by deep, tribal grooves and energetic rhythms that promise a hypnotic journey on the dance floor. Joining him is Jesse Zotti, rounding out a lineup poised to deliver the immersive vibe Pendulum is known for.

Pendulum's Return to Tulum

Pendulum returns to Tulum for a select series of shows, building on its highly acclaimed residency from 2025. This event series, presented by Vagalume, has established itself as a platform for curated electronic music experiences within Tulum's vibrant scene. Each session under the Pendulum banner focuses on creating an atmosphere where the music, dramatic lighting, and natural surroundings converge for a distinct collective experience.

Vagalume's Jungle-Beach Setting

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the Hotel Zone, offers a unique backdrop for Pendulum. As a premium beach club, it transitions from daytime serenity to a lively nighttime hub, drawing a diverse crowd of international visitors and locals. The venue's open-air setting, with its stunning beachfront views and integration with the jungle, enhances the musical journey, allowing the pounding rhythms to sync with the sway of the palms.

The event runs from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering an extended evening of music. Tickets for this Pendulum session start at $605 MXN for Early Bird, progressing through First, Second, and Final Release tiers up to $1,540 MXN. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a "Tulum Style" dress code. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking a more exclusive experience.

en.body:
Tabu, Raidho & Renatta Debut at Vagalume

This edition of This. Place, presented by Vagalume, brings a lineup featuring two prominent Polish electronic projects alongside local talent. Tabu, a duo that gained recognition in 2024 with their remix of Bad Bunny’s “Dakiti,” has seen their work featured in playlists by artists such as Keinemusik, BLOND:ISH, and Tiesto. Their recent collaboration with Maesic, “RIPSAW,” has been signed to Kitsuné Musique. Joining them is Raidho, a veteran of the Polish club scene with over two decades of experience, known for his affiliation with the New York-based Sol Selectas label and for sharing stages with notable electronic music figures globally. Completing the bill is Renatta, who contributes the distinct energy of the local Tulum scene, ensuring a blend of international and regional electronic music.

Vagalume's Beachfront Setting

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the vibrant Hotel Zone, offers a premium beachfront experience that transitions from daytime serenity to nighttime energy. Known as a central hub for music and events in Tulum, the venue provides a high-end atmosphere with stunning views of the Caribbean Sea. Its design and location create an environment where electronic music, ranging from Deep House to Melodic Techno, resonates within a lively mix of international and local attendees. Vagalume's reputation for energetic parties makes it a fitting location for this event.

Tickets and Entry Details

This. Place at Vagalume is scheduled for January 21st, 2026, with the event running from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM. Tickets are available across several tiers, starting with Early Bird at $605 MXN, progressing to First Release at $880 MXN, Second Release at $1,210 MXN, and Final Release at $1,540 MXN. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a "Tulum Style" dress code. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking an elevated experience.

en.body:
Anticipating the Renaissance Lineup

Renaissance makes its anticipated return to the Mayan Riviera in 2026, presented by Vagalume. This edition promises four exclusive dates, each set to feature a carefully curated selection from "the world’s best DJs, both established and emerging." While the specific lineup remains unannounced, the series' reputation and Vagalume's typical programming suggest a focus on Deep House, Progressive House, and Melodic Techno, ensuring a sophisticated electronic journey for attendees.

A Legacy Returns to Tulum

Renaissance, a name deeply embedded in the history of electronic music, brings its renowned event series back to its beautiful home on the Mayan Riviera. Originating in the UK in the early 1990s, Renaissance quickly became a global institution, celebrated for its pioneering compilations and transformative club nights that helped define the progressive house and techno sound. Its presence in Tulum continues a tradition of delivering high-caliber electronic music experiences in visually striking and culturally rich settings.

Under the Vagalume Tepee

The series unfolds at Vagalume Tulum, a premium beach club known for its energetic parties and high-end atmosphere within Tulum's Hotel Zone. The venue transitions seamlessly from a serene daytime spot to a vibrant nighttime destination. The event description highlights a "hallowed tepee," suggesting a distinctive architectural element that will house the dancefloor, creating an intimate and immersive environment. This setting, with its beachfront views and sophisticated design, perfectly complements the electronic music styles presented by Renaissance.

Entry to the Mayan Riviera Session

Renaissance Tulum 2026 runs from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, inviting guests to immerse themselves in the "Tulum Style" dress code. Tickets are available in several tiers, starting with Early Bird at $605 MXN, progressing through First Release ($880 MXN), Second Release ($1,210 MXN), and Final Release ($1,540 MXN). For an enhanced experience, VIP tables with bottle service are also available. Securing tickets in advance is recommended for this popular series.

en.body:
This. Place Showcases European Talent in Tulum

The latest edition of This. Place brings a curated selection of European electronic music talent to Vagalume Tulum, featuring EWEERSEEN from UNRELEASED RECORDS, SINCZ representing ATLANT RENAISSANCE, and VACOS. This lineup highlights top DJs and producers from Poland and their counterparts from across Europe, promising a session rooted in the melodic and progressive sounds often associated with the region's electronic music scene. Attendees can anticipate a journey through various facets of house and melodic techno, consistent with Vagalume's established musical identity.

From Polish Roots to Global Stages

This. Place, a project originating from Poland, has been a notable presence in the electronic music landscape since its inception in 2019. Known for staging events in distinctive and often unconventional venues, such as historic theaters, museums, and rooftop locations, the series quickly garnered a dedicated following. Its reputation for selling out 90% of its events underscores its appeal and the quality of its curated experiences, establishing it as a significant collective in the international scene.

Vagalume Tulum's Beachfront Rhythms

Vagalume Tulum provides the backdrop for this residency, a premium beach club situated in Tulum's vibrant hotel zone. Renowned for its energetic parties and high-end atmosphere, Vagalume transitions seamlessly from a serene daytime setting to a lively nighttime hub. Its beachfront location offers stunning views of the Caribbean Sea, creating an immersive environment where the sounds of Deep House, Progressive House, and Melodic Techno resonate with the natural beauty of the coast. The venue's design and ambiance are well-suited to hosting events that blend sophisticated electronic music with a vibrant social experience.

Entry Details for This. Place

The event runs from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, inviting guests to immerse themselves in the "Tulum Style" dress code. Tickets for this session begin at $605 MXN for Early Bird access, with prices escalating to $1,540 MXN for Final Release. Given This. Place's history of high demand and sold-out events, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking an elevated experience.

The series is built around the concept of total immersion, blending artistic and musical elements to create a heightened entertainment experience, distinguished by its unmistakable visual identity and surrealist themes.

De las costas de Ibiza a las arenas de Tulum

Gala, concebida por Ibán Mendoza, se originó en Ibiza, estableciéndose en la Isla Blanca antes de embarcarse en una expansión internacional. Este próximo evento marca su segundo año consecutivo regresando a Vagalume en Tulum, solidificando su presencia en la escena de la música electrónica mexicana. en.body:
Mita Gami's Melodic Trajectory

Mita Gami has established himself as a prominent figure within the melodic house and indie dance scenes, known for constructing sets that traverse driving rhythms and evocative synthesizer melodies. His career trajectory has seen him cultivate a distinctive sound, often exploring the intersection of house and techno with intricate layering and atmospheric depth. Collaborations with influential artists like Adam Ten have yielded tracks that have resonated across global dancefloors, solidifying his reputation for crafting compelling electronic music. His consistent presence on esteemed labels such as Diynamic and Crosstown Rebels further underscores his significant standing in the contemporary electronic music landscape.

Recent Crosstown Rebels & Diynamic Output

Mita Gami's musical style is characterized by its fluid movement between indie dance, melodic house, and melodic techno, frequently employing robust basslines, syncopated percussion, and shimmering synth textures. His recent output in 2025 includes the "Secret Places Remix EP," a collaborative effort with Adam Ten released on Diynamic in August, showcasing their combined prowess in crafting emotionally resonant grooves. Further cementing his sound, the "Untouchable EP" and the single "Million Pieces" both arrived on Crosstown Rebels in July and May 2025 respectively, each demonstrating his knack for intricate production and dancefloor-ready appeal. With a dedicated following of over 28,000 Spotify followers, Mita Gami's tracks consistently find their way into curated playlists and DJ sets worldwide, reflecting his broad appeal within the scene.

Sinner's Fourth Season at Vagalume

This performance sees Mita Gami taking the decks for Sinner, the boutique party series entering its fourth season at Vagalume Tulum, renowned for its high-end atmosphere and energetic parties. Expect Mita Gami to navigate through his signature blend of indie dance and melodic techno, building a set that perfectly complements Vagalume's stunning beachfront setting and vibrant energy. The event, conceptualized by DJs and producers VITE and Miganova, promises an evening where their foundational grooves will set the stage for Mita Gami's intricate soundscapes, ensuring a seamless flow of music. Vagalume's premium location, known for its transformation from daytime serenity to nighttime excitement, provides an ideal backdrop for Mita Gami's sophisticated sonic journey, enhanced by the venue's exceptional acoustics.

Planning Your Sinner Night

The Sinner event featuring Mita Gami commences at 3:00 PM on December 27th at Vagalume Tulum, offering an extended experience from late afternoon into the evening. Tickets for this premium beach club affair start at $880 MXN, reflecting the high-end atmosphere and caliber of international talent. Given Vagalume's popularity as Tulum's most iconic beach club and its reputation for memorable events, advanced reservations are highly recommended to secure entry and enjoy the venue's acclaimed Mexican and Caribbean fusion menu.

La trayectoria de su carrera le ha llevado a cultivar un sonido distintivo, a menudo explorando la intersección del house y el techno con intrincadas capas y profundidad atmosférica. Colaboraciones con artistas influyentes como Adam Ten han dado lugar a temas que han resonado en las pistas de baile de todo el mundo, consolidando su reputación de creador de música electrónica convincente. Su presencia constante en sellos de prestigio como Diynamic y Crosstown Rebels subraya aún más su importante posición en el panorama de la música electrónica contemporánea

El estilo musical de Mita Gami se caracteriza por su movimiento fluido entre el indie dance, el house melódico y el techno melódico, empleando con frecuencia líneas de bajo robustas, percusión sincopada y texturas de sintetizador resplandecientes. Su producción más reciente en 2025 incluye "Secret Places Remix EP", un trabajo de colaboración con Adam Ten publicado en Diynamic en agosto, en el que muestran su habilidad combinada para crear ritmos emocionalmente resonantes. Para consolidar aún más su sonido, el "Untouchable EP" y el single "Million Pieces" aparecieron en Crosstown Rebels en julio y mayo de 2025 respectivamente, demostrando su habilidad para la producción intrincada y su atractivo para la pista de baile. Con más de 28.000 seguidores en Spotify, las canciones de Mita Gami se cuelan constantemente en listas de reproducción y sesiones de DJ de todo el mundo, lo que refleja su gran atractivo dentro de la escena

El evento, conceptualizado por los DJs y productores VITE y Miganova, promete una velada en la que sus ritmos fundacionales prepararán el escenario para los intrincados paisajes sonoros de Mita Gami, garantizando un flujo musical ininterrumpido. en.body:
Bora Uzer's Eclectic Journey

Hailing from Turkey, Bora Uzer has cultivated a distinctive presence in the electronic music landscape, initially gaining recognition as a key member of the alternative group Kangroove. His transition to a solo career saw him explore a broader musical spectrum, marked by his debut album and notable collaborations. Uzer's early solo work, including the track "You Are," found its way onto the European compilation "Grillenundchillen," signaling his international reach. Further cementing his diverse artistic connections, he featured as a guest artist on İlhan Erşahin’s "Harikalar Diyarı" album, showcasing his versatility beyond conventional electronic genres.

Organic House and Pop Fusion

Bora Uzer's musical style navigates a compelling intersection of organic house and Turkish pop, constructing sets that blend rhythmic sophistication with melodic accessibility. While his discography includes earlier albums like "B1" (2009) and "Benim Umrumda" (2018), his recent output includes the "Cybernetic Symphony" single, released in May 2025. Tracks such as "Sensiz," "Sammaye," and "Mujer Estrella" are frequently highlighted by his audience, demonstrating his ability to craft memorable compositions.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance by Bora Uzer at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an evening where his signature organic house grooves will unfold within one of Tulum's premier nightlife destinations. Bonbonniere, known as the only nightclub open until late in the Hotel Zone, offers a luxurious ambiance complemented by a state-of-the-art sound system and a retractable roof, enhancing the sonic and visual experience. Uzer's set is expected to leverage these features, building from intricate, percussive rhythms to more expansive, melodic soundscapes, perfectly suited for the venue's energetic dance floor and sophisticated atmosphere. The club's reputation for hosting world-class artists ensures a high-fidelity experience for attendees.

Entry and Dress Code Enforcement

Bora Uzer's performance is scheduled for Thursday, December 25th, starting at 10 PM and continuing till late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to uphold its sophisticated atmosphere. Entry will be refused to individuals not complying with the dress code; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are explicitly prohibited. Given Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot and its premium audience, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended.

es.body:
El ecléctico viaje de Bora Uzer

Procedente de Turquía, Bora Uzer ha cultivado una presencia distintiva en el panorama de la música electrónica, ganando reconocimiento inicialmente como miembro clave del grupo alternativo Kangroove. Su transición a una carrera en solitario le llevó a explorar un espectro musical más amplio, marcado por su álbum de debut y notables colaboraciones. Los primeros trabajos en solitario de Uzer, incluido el tema "You Are", se incluyeron en el recopilatorio europeo "Grillenundchillen", lo que indica su alcance internacional. Para cimentar aún más sus diversas conexiones artísticas, participó como artista invitado en el álbum "Harikalar Diyarı" de İlhan Erşahin, mostrando su versatilidad más allá de los géneros electrónicos convencionales.

House orgánico y fusión pop

El estilo musical de Bora Uzer navega por una atractiva intersección de house orgánico y pop turco, construyendo conjuntos que mezclan sofisticación rítmica con accesibilidad melódica. Si bien su discografía incluye álbumes anteriores como "B1" (2009) y "Benim Umrumda" (2018), su producción reciente incluye el single "Cybernetic Symphony", publicado en mayo de 2025. Temas como "Sensiz", "Sammaye" y "Mujer Estrella" son frecuentemente destacados por su público, demostrando su habilidad para elaborar composiciones memorables.

Tarde en la noche en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación de Bora Uzer en Bonbonniere Tulum promete una velada en la que se desplegarán sus característicos ritmos house orgánicos en uno de los principales destinos nocturnos de Tulum. Bonbonniere, conocido como el único club nocturno abierto hasta tarde en la Zona Hotelera, ofrece un ambiente de lujo complementado con un sistema de sonido de última generación y un techo retráctil, mejorando la experiencia sonora y visual. Se espera que la actuación de Uzer aproveche estas características, desde ritmos intrincados y percusivos hasta paisajes sonoros más amplios y melódicos, perfectamente adaptados a la enérgica pista de baile y al sofisticado ambiente del local. La reputación del club como anfitrión de artistas de talla mundial garantiza una experiencia de alta fidelidad para los asistentes.

La actuación de Bora Uzer está prevista para el jueves 25 de diciembre, a partir de las 22.00 horas y hasta tarde. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN. en.body:
Dubfire & Nicole Moudaber: Techno Architects

Dubfire, the Iranian-American artist born Ali Shirazinia, from his Grammy-winning Deep Dish progressive house roots to a driving force in techno, establishing his SCI+TEC imprint as a platform for dark, percussive sounds. Alongside him, Lebanese-British DJ and producer Nicole Moudaber has carved her own formidable presence in the global techno scene, known for her relentless energy and the influential MOOD Records label, complemented by her widely syndicated In The MOOD radio show. Both artists have cultivated careers defined by uncompromising techno aesthetics, frequently headlining major festivals and clubs worldwide, solidifying their positions as stalwarts of the genre.

Driving Rhythms and Industrial Textures

The combined musical style of Dubfire and Nicole Moudaber explores the deeper, more industrial facets of techno, characterized by driving four-to-the-floor kicks, intricate percussive layers, and hypnotic, often dark, melodic motifs. Dubfire's solo work, including popular tracks like "CORA DE HIELO," "NIENTIENDO," and "PLAY DOH," often navigates minimal techno structures with a powerful, functional edge, evidenced by his recent 2025 singles "HnC??" (April 25), "HOLLABACKGIRRRRRL??" (April 4), and "Chanel??" (March 3). Moudaber, in turn, injects a raw, tribal energy into her sets, frequently incorporating robust basslines and syncopated rhythms. Their b2b sets are a masterclass in complementary mixing, blending their individual strengths into a cohesive, high-impact sonic journey.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum on January 2nd, 2026, promises an extended journey through the darker spectrum of techno as Dubfire and Nicole Moudaber deliver a highly anticipated back-to-back set. Attendees can expect a dynamic progression from deep, hypnotic grooves to peak-time industrial techno, showcasing their renowned synergy and track selection. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and the unique ambiance of its retractable roof, which opens to the starlit sky, will perfectly complement the artists' expansive soundscapes. No supporting acts are listed for this specific event, indicating a substantial set from the headliners themselves, ensuring the dance floor remains energized until late.

Entry and Dress Code at Bonbonniere

Doors for this event open on Friday, January 2nd, with the performance scheduled to run from 10 PM. Tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to Bonbonniere's exclusive nightlife experience. A strictly enforced formal dress code is in effect, prohibiting beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts to maintain the venue's sophisticated atmosphere. Paid valet parking is available, and advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended to secure entry to this premier Tulum event.

es.body:
Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber: Techno Architects

Dubfire, el artista iraní-estadounidense nacido Ali Shirazinia, pasó de sus raíces en el house progresivo Deep Dish, ganador de un Grammy, a convertirse en una fuerza impulsora del techno, estableciendo su sello SCI+TEC como plataforma de sonidos oscuros y percusivos. Junto a él, la DJ y productora libanesa-británica Nicole Moudaber se ha labrado su propia y formidable presencia en la escena mundial del techno, conocida por su implacable energía y el influyente sello MOOD Records, complementado por su programa de radio In The MOOD, ampliamente difundido. Ambas artistas han cultivado carreras definidas por una estética techno sin concesiones, actuando con frecuencia como cabezas de cartel en importantes festivales y clubes de todo el mundo, consolidando sus posiciones como incondicionales del género.

Ritmos contundentes y texturas industriales

El estilo musical combinado de Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber explora las facetas más profundas e industriales del techno, caracterizado por ritmos contundentes, intrincadas capas de percusión y motivos melódicos hipnóticos, a menudo oscuros. El trabajo en solitario de Dubfire, que incluye temas populares como "CORA DE HIELO", "NIENTIENDO" y "PLAY DOH", a menudo navega por estructuras de techno minimalista con un toque potente y funcional, como demuestran sus recientes 2025 singles "HnC??" (25 de abril), "HOLLABACKGIRRRRRL??" (4 de abril) y "Chanel??" (3 de marzo) (3 de marzo). Moudaber, por su parte, inyecta una energía cruda y tribal a sus sets, incorporando con frecuencia robustas líneas de bajo y ritmos sincopados. Sus sesiones b2b son una clase magistral de mezclas complementarias, que combinan sus puntos fuertes individuales en un viaje sonoro cohesivo y de gran impacto.

Tarde en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum, el 2 de enero de 2026, promete un largo viaje a través del espectro más oscuro del techno, ya que Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber ofrecerán un esperado set back-to-back. Los asistentes pueden esperar una progresión dinámica desde grooves profundos e hipnóticos hasta el techno industrial de máxima audiencia, mostrando su reconocida sinergia y selección de temas. El sistema de sonido de última generación de Bonbonniere y el ambiente único de su techo retráctil, que se abre al cielo estrellado, complementarán a la perfección los amplios paisajes sonoros de los artistas. Para este evento en concreto no se han programado actuaciones de apoyo, lo que indica que los cabezas de cartel ofrecerán un set sustancial que garantizará que la pista de baile se mantenga animada hasta tarde.

Entrada y código de vestimenta en Bonbonniere

Los boletos tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN y ofrecen acceso a la exclusiva experiencia nocturna de Bonbonniere. Un estricto código de vestimenta formal está en vigor, prohibiendo atuendos de playa como trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos para mantener el ambiente sofisticado del lugar. Hay servicio de aparcacoches de pago disponible, y se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de entradas para asegurar la entrada a este evento de primera clase en Tulum.

Damian Lazarus

Damian Lazarus, a UK-born DJ, producer, and A&R, has been a pivotal figure in electronic music for over two decades. His career began significantly as Head of A&R for City Rockers, where he signed influential acts before founding his own imprint, Crosstown Rebels, in 2003. This label became a cornerstone for a distinctive sound blending deep house, techno, and an ethereal, often psychedelic aesthetic. Beyond his DJ sets, Lazarus has also explored live performance with his band, Damian Lazarus & The Ancient Moons, releasing albums like "Smoke the Monster Out" and "Message from the Other Side," showcasing a broader musical vision.

Shamanic Rhythms & Ethereal Soundscapes

Lazarus's musical style navigates a spectrum of deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno, characterized by its hypnotic grooves, intricate percussion, and often mystical vocal samples. His productions frequently explore extended sonic journeys, building tension and release through layers of analog warmth and subtle, evolving melodies. His recent album, "Magickal," released in January 2025, exemplifies this approach, featuring tracks that traverse introspective soundscapes and driving, four-to-the-floor rhythms. Further expanding this body of work, the "Magickal Remixed" album is slated for release in October 2025. Tracks like "Into The Sun" and "Don't Be Afraid"

Wednesday Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises a deep dive into Lazarus's expansive sonic universe, unfolding within the venue's luxurious yet energetic nightclub setting. Attendees can expect a typical Lazarus set to progress from atmospheric, percussive warm-ups into more driving, melodic techno and progressive house as the night deepens. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and production, complemented by its retractable roof that opens to the starlit sky, are ideally suited to enhance the intricate layers and immersive qualities of his sound. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, January 15th, extending late into the morning, ensuring ample time for a comprehensive musical journey.

Entry & Attire Guidelines

Access to this exclusive event at Bonbonniere Tulum begins with tickets priced at $1,100 MXN. Doors open at 10 pm, with the night expected to build towards peak hours after midnight, continuing until late. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to preserve its sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire, including caps, shorts, sandals, sports shirts, and swimwear, is not permitted. Given the venue's popularity and the caliber of the artist, purchasing tickets in advance is highly recommended to secure entry.

es.body:
Damian Lazarus

Damian Lazarus, DJ, productor y A&R nacido en el Reino Unido, ha sido una figura fundamental en la música electrónica durante más de dos décadas. Su carrera comenzó como Jefe de A&R de City Rockers, donde firmó influyentes proyectos antes de fundar su propio sello, Crosstown Rebels, en 2003. Este sello se convirtió en la piedra angular de un sonido distintivo que combina deep house, techno y una estética etérea, a menudo psicodélica. Más allá de sus sesiones como DJ, Lazarus también ha explorado las actuaciones en directo con su banda, Damian Lazarus & The Ancient Moons, y ha publicado álbumes como "Smoke the Monster Out" y "Message from the Other Side", en los que muestra una visión musical más amplia.

Ritmos chamánicos y paisajes sonoros etéreos

El estilo musical de Lazarus navega por un espectro de deep house, progressive house y techno melódico, caracterizado por sus grooves hipnóticos, percusión intrincada y muestras vocales a menudo místicas. Sus producciones exploran con frecuencia viajes sónicos prolongados, creando tensión y liberación a través de capas de calidez analógica y melodías sutiles y cambiantes. Su reciente álbum, "Magickal", publicado en enero de 2025, ejemplifica este enfoque, con temas que atraviesan paisajes sonoros introspectivos y ritmos contundentes. El álbum "Magickal Remixed", que amplía esta línea de trabajo, saldrá a la venta en octubre de 2025. Temas como "Into The Sun" y "Don't Be Afraid"

Miércoles por la noche en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete una inmersión profunda en el universo sónico expansivo de Lazarus, que se desarrollará en el lujoso y enérgico ambiente nocturno del local. Los asistentes pueden esperar que un set típico de Lazarus progrese desde un calentamiento atmosférico y percusivo a un techno y house progresivo más impulsivo y melódico a medida que la noche se hace más profunda. El sistema de sonido y la producción de vanguardia de Bonbonniere, complementados por su techo retráctil que se abre al cielo estrellado, son ideales para realzar las intrincadas capas y las cualidades envolventes de su sonido. El evento está programado para el miércoles 15 de enero y se prolongará hasta altas horas de la madrugada, lo que garantiza tiempo suficiente para un viaje musical completo.

Normas de acceso y vestimenta

El acceso a este evento exclusivo en Bonbonniere Tulum comienza con boletos a un precio de $1,100 MXN. Las puertas se abren a las 10 pm, y se espera que la noche llegue a su punto máximo después de la medianoche, continuando hasta tarde. Bonbonniere mantiene un estricto código de vestimenta elegante-formal para preservar su ambiente sofisticado; no se permite la vestimenta de playa, incluyendo gorras, pantalones cortos, sandalias, camisetas deportivas y trajes de baño. Dada la popularidad del lugar y el calibre de los artistas, se recomienda encarecidamente comprar las entradas con antelación para asegurarse la entrada.
