Bontan's House Music Ascent

Bontan has established himself as a significant force within the global house music landscape, recognized for his impactful productions and dynamic DJ sets. Hailing from the UK, his career trajectory is marked by a consistent output of high-charting releases, earning him the Best Newcomer award at the DJ Awards. Bontan's sound, deeply rooted in the underground house scene, has found a home on esteemed labels such as Hot Creations, 20/20 Vision, Elrow Music, and Circus Recordings, solidifying his position as a Beatport best-selling artist.

Rhythmic Explorations in House

Bontan's musical style navigates the vibrant territories of afro house, tech house, tribal house, and latin house, characterized by driving rhythms and infectious grooves. His productions often feature robust four-to-the-floor kicks, intricate percussion, and soulful vocal samples, creating a sound designed for peak-time dancefloors. Recent releases from 2025 include the singles "La Candelaria" (July 2025), "Too Much" (August 2025), and "That's Right" (October 2025), showcasing his continued evolution on various imprints. With over 26,000 Spotify followers, popular tracks like "This Is My Life - Bontan Remix" and "Wile Out (feat. Surya Sen)" highlight his ability to craft widely appealing yet credible club anthems.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an extended journey through Bontan's diverse house sound, from the percussive depths of afro house to the driving energy of tech house. The venue's state-of-the-art sound system and production, coupled with its retractable roof, will enhance Bontan's rhythmic selections, creating an immersive experience under the starlit sky. Bonbonniere's reputation as Tulum's premier late-night destination, known for hosting world-class artists, provides an ideal backdrop for Bontan's energetic and sophisticated style, ensuring the dance floor remains vibrant until the early hours.

Entry & Dress Code Enforcement

Doors for this event at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with Bontan expected to command the decks until late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Attendees should note that a formal dress code is strictly enforced to maintain the venue's luxurious ambiance; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted. Given Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot in Tulum's bustling hotel zone, early arrival is advisable to secure entry and fully experience the night.

Sparrow's musical style is characterized by its polyrhythmic foundation, often incorporating organic percussion and warm basslines that define the afro house and tribal house subgenres. Tracks such as "Lady (Hear Me Tonight) - Remix," "Champion," and "Dream" exemplify his ability to craft infectious grooves that maintain both dancefloor energy and melodic depth. While specific production techniques are not widely detailed, the warmth and texture in his releases suggest a meticulous approach to sound design, often leaning into analog-inspired textures. With over 32,506 Spotify followers, Sparrow's work consistently reaches a dedicated listenership drawn to his distinctive fusion of global rhythms.

An Evening of Global Grooves at Bonbonniere

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an immersive journey through Sparrow's signature sound, likely progressing from deep, percussive afro house into more energetic latin house and afro tech selections as the night unfolds. Supporting acts Ape Drums and Bensy will set the stage, building the atmosphere before Sparrow takes control. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and its unique retractable roof, which offers views of the starlit sky, are ideally suited to Sparrow's expansive, rhythm-focused productions, enhancing the communal dance experience in this luxurious yet energetic setting.

Essential Information for the Night

Doors for this event at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with the night expected to continue until late, making it a prime afterparty destination in the Hotel Zone. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Attendees should note the strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, or sport shorts will not be permitted. Advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended to secure entry and avoid potential increases at the door.

en.body:
Ayybo

Southern California's Ayybo, born Aaron Bonnema, has rapidly established himself as a prominent figure in the house music landscape, known for his high-energy tech-house productions and dynamic DJ sets. Transitioning from a background as a drummer and school DJ, Ayybo has cultivated a sound that skillfully blends hip-hop, bass, and house influences, earning him a dedicated following. His career trajectory was significantly boosted by viral hits like "Hypnosis," which garnered widespread attention and even led to an official remix by Pitbull, solidifying his position in the electronic music scene.

High-Energy Tech-House & Recent Works

Ayybo's musical style navigates the energetic realms of tech house and house, characterized by driving rhythms and infectious grooves that often incorporate vocal hooks and robust basslines. His production techniques lean into creating immediate dancefloor impact, drawing from his diverse influences to construct tracks that are both technically proficient and widely appealing. Demonstrating his prolific output, recent releases from 2025 include the "Rizz (Millero Remix)" single, "4 Ya Mind" single, and his remix of "Nothing Wrong (AYYBO Remix)," all showcasing his evolving sound. With popular tracks like "RIZZ," "HYPNOSIS," and "DRENCH," Ayybo commands a significant presence, evidenced by his 123,727 Spotify followers.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises a high-octane set, with Ayybo expected to deliver his signature blend of high-energy tech-house that keeps the dancefloor engaged until late. Bonbonniere, renowned as Tulum's premier late-night destination, offers a luxurious yet lively atmosphere perfectly suited for Ayybo's driving sound, with its state-of-the-art sound system and retractable roof enhancing the experience. As a central afterparty spot in the Hotel Zone, the venue's energetic ambiance and focus on world-class electronic artists will complement Ayybo's style, ensuring a night of continuous movement.

Entry & Dress Code

Doors for Ayybo's performance at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with the event continuing until late into the morning. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Guests should note that Bonbonniere strictly enforces an elegant-formal dress code to maintain its sophisticated atmosphere. Entry will be refused for non-compliance; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted.

es.body:
Ayybo

Ayybo, nacido en el sur de California, Aaron Bonnema, se ha establecido rápidamente como una figura prominente en el panorama de la música house, conocido por sus producciones tech-house de alta energía y sus dinámicos DJ sets. Ayybo, que se formó como batería y DJ de escuela, ha cultivado un sonido que mezcla hábilmente influencias del hip-hop, el bajo y el house, lo que le ha granjeado un gran número de seguidores. La trayectoria de su carrera se vio impulsada significativamente por éxitos virales como "Hypnosis", que acaparó la atención general e incluso dio lugar a una remezcla oficial de Pitbull, consolidando su posición en la escena de la música electrónica

Tech-House de alta energía y trabajos recientes

El estilo musical de Ayybo navega por los enérgicos reinos del tech house y el house, caracterizado por ritmos enérgicos y grooves contagiosos que a menudo incorporan ganchos vocales y robustas líneas de bajo. Sus técnicas de producción se inclinan hacia la creación de un impacto inmediato en la pista de baile, basándose en sus diversas influencias para construir pistas que son a la vez técnicamente competentes y ampliamente atractivas. Como muestra de su prolífica producción, entre los últimos lanzamientos de 2025 se encuentran el single "Rizz (Millero Remix)", el single "4 Ya Mind" y su remezcla de "Nothing Wrong (AYYBO Remix)", que muestran la evolución de su sonido. Con temas tan populares como "RIZZ", "HYPNOSIS" y "DRENCH", Ayybo tiene una presencia significativa, como demuestran sus 123.727 seguidores de Spotify

Late Night en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete un set de alto octanaje, en el que se espera que Ayybo ofrezca su característica mezcla de tech-house de alta energía que mantiene la pista de baile ocupada hasta tarde. Bonbonniere, conocido por ser el principal destino nocturno de Tulum, ofrece un ambiente lujoso y animado que se adapta perfectamente al sonido de Ayybo, con un sistema de sonido de última generación y un techo retráctil que mejoran la experiencia. Como lugar central de afterparty en la Zona Hotelera, el ambiente enérgico del local y su enfoque en artistas electrónicos de talla mundial complementarán el estilo de Ayybo, asegurando una noche de continuo movimiento

Entrada y código de vestimenta

Las puertas para la actuación de Ayybo en Bonbonniere Tulum se abren a las 10 PM, y el evento continuará hasta altas horas de la madrugada. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN. Los invitados deben tener en cuenta que Bonbonniere aplica estrictamente un código de vestimenta elegante-formal para mantener su ambiente sofisticado. Se denegará la entrada en caso de incumplimiento; no se permite el uso de atuendos playeros como trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos.

en.body:
Sasha: Charting Emotional Narratives

Sasha, the acclaimed singer-songwriter from Boston, Massachusetts, has established a significant presence in the indie-pop and alternative pop landscape. Known for her introspective lyrics and raw emotional honesty, she crafts melodic narratives that resonate deeply with listeners. Before launching her successful performing career, Sasha gained recognition as a songwriter for various prominent artists, solidifying her reputation for poignant storytelling. With a substantial following of over 1.7 million on Spotify, her distinct voice and candid approach have garnered a dedicated global audience.

Introspective Pop Soundscapes

Sasha's musical style navigates melancholic pop melodies, often featuring a blend of acoustic instrumentation and subtle electronic textures. Her production creates an intimate yet expansive sound, serving as a backdrop for her vulnerable and candid lyrical themes. Her 2024 album, "Me Again," released on May 17, 2024, continued her exploration of personal introspection, building on the success of previous albums like 2022's "I Blame The World" and 2020's "Only Child." Tracks such as "Dancing With Your Ghost," "Older," and "Hero" exemplify her ability to craft emotionally resonant pop anthems.

Sasha's Tulum Session at Vagalume

For this Vagalume Sessions event, Sasha is set to deliver a unique performance within Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene. While Vagalume Tulum is renowned for its energetic deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno events, Sasha's appearance suggests a special live vocal set, potentially incorporating electronic reinterpretations of her acclaimed tracks. The evening will also feature sets from supporting artists Hardt Antoine, Neo Human, and Nadi Cabbad, who will contribute to the event's "beats, rhythms, and shared experiences" atmosphere. Vagalume's premium beachfront setting, known for its lively energy and high-end ambiance, offers a distinctive backdrop for Sasha's introspective pop to intertwine with the club's typical electronic pulse.

Event Details & Ticketing

VAGALUME SESSIONS PRESENTS: SASHA is scheduled from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering a full day and night of music and connection. Early Bird Tickets are available starting at $605 MXN, with prices increasing through subsequent releases. The dress code is "TULUM STYLE," encouraging a relaxed yet chic aesthetic fitting for the premium beach club environment. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking an elevated experience, with inquiries directed via WhatsApp. Securing tickets in advance is highly recommended for this electronic extravaganza at Vagalume Tulum.

Golden Tempo's musical style navigates the rich landscapes of reggae and ska, characterized by syncopated rhythms, prominent basslines, and brass-driven melodies often infused with Latin American influences. Their latest album, "Jungle Vybz," released in July 2024, showcases their continued exploration of these foundational genres, blending traditional elements with modern production. Tracks like "Aire," "Luz," and "Oh No" exemplify their ability to craft catchy, rhythmically complex compositions that have garnered significant streaming attention.

en.body:
Never Dull

San Diego native Never Dull has cultivated a distinct presence in electronic music since 2017, channeling his Latin American heritage and Californian upbringing into an energizing, groovy sound. Known for a prolific output that includes over 100 official tracks, his discography spans original productions, disco edits, and remixes. Never Dull's approach is centered on sharing positive vibes, establishing him as a consistent purveyor of feel-good dance music for audiences globally.

Funk-Infused House Aesthetics

Never Dull's musical style navigates through disco house, funky house, jazz house, nu disco, and lo-fi house, characterized by a vibrant, rhythm-driven aesthetic. His production techniques often involve sampling and re-contextualizing classic disco and funk elements, creating tracks like "Deep Down - Never Dull's In My Mind Edit," "Saxyness," and "The Time Is Now." The artist's latest single, "BIG DISCO ENERGY," released in December 2025, further exemplifies his commitment to upbeat, dancefloor-focused productions. With 64,610 Spotify followers, Never Dull maintains a significant reach within the contemporary house scene.

Full Moon Rhythms at Papaya Playa

This performance at Papaya Playa Project's Full Moon Celebration on March 7th promises an evening of Never Dull's signature energizing grooves, perfectly complementing Tulum's beachfront atmosphere. Expect a set that progressively builds from soulful, disco-infused rhythms to more driving house selections, designed to keep the dancefloor moving under the moonlight. The natural beauty and eco-conscious spirit of Papaya Playa Project, with its open-air setting and focus on soulful sounds, provide an ideal backdrop for Never Dull's positive and vibrant musical delivery. The lineup also features additional artists, with "MORE TBA" indicating further announcements to enhance the night's sonic journey.

Planning Your Tulum Escape

The Full Moon Celebration at Papaya Playa Project is scheduled for Saturday, March 7th, commencing at 18:00. General admission tickets are priced at $1,430 MXN. Guests can enhance their evening with a Mayan Dinner Experience or opt for room packages, offering a comprehensive anniversary weekend escape. Given Papaya Playa Project's reputation as an upscale destination and its history of hosting significant events, securing tickets in advance is advisable to ensure entry to this celestial night of beats.

es.body:
Never Dull

Never Dull, nativo de San Diego, ha cultivado una presencia distintiva en la música electrónica desde 2017, canalizando su herencia latinoamericana y su crianza californiana en un sonido energizante y groovy. Conocido por una prolífica producción que incluye más de 100 pistas oficiales, su discografía abarca producciones originales, ediciones disco y remezclas. El enfoque de Never Dull se centra en compartir vibraciones positivas, lo que le ha convertido en un proveedor constante de música de baile que hace sentir bien al público de todo el mundo.

Estética house con toques funk

El estilo musical de Never Dull navega entre el disco house, el funky house, el jazz house, el nu disco y el lo-fi house, caracterizado por una estética vibrante y rítmica. Sus técnicas de producción a menudo implican el muestreo y la recontextualización de elementos disco y funk clásicos, creando temas como "Deep Down - Never Dull's In My Mind Edit", "Saxyness" y "The Time Is Now" El último single del artista, "BIG DISCO ENERGY", publicado en diciembre de 2025, ejemplifica aún más su compromiso con las producciones optimistas y centradas en la pista de baile. Con 64.610 seguidores en Spotify, Never Dull mantiene un alcance significativo dentro de la escena house contemporánea.

Ritmos de luna llena en Papaya Playa

Esta actuación en Papaya Playa Project's Full Moon Celebration el 7 de marzo promete una noche de los ritmos energéticos característicos de Never Dull, que complementan perfectamente el ambiente frente a la playa de Tulum. Se espera un set que va progresivamente de ritmos soul y disco a selecciones house más movidas, diseñadas para mantener la pista de baile en movimiento bajo la luz de la luna. La belleza natural y el espíritu ecológico de Papaya Playa Project, con su entorno al aire libre y su enfoque en los sonidos soulful, proporcionan un telón de fondo ideal para la entrega musical positiva y vibrante de Never Dull. El cartel también cuenta con artistas adicionales, con "MORE TBA" indicando más anuncios para mejorar el viaje sonoro de la noche.

Planea tu escapada a Tulum

La celebración de la luna llena en Papaya Playa Project está programada para el sábado 7 de marzo, a partir de las 18:00 horas. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,430 MXN. Los huéspedes pueden mejorar su velada con una Experiencia de Cena Maya u optar por paquetes de habitaciones, ofreciendo una escapada completa de fin de semana de aniversario. Dada la reputación de Papaya Playa Project como destino de lujo y su historial como anfitrión de eventos importantes, es aconsejable asegurar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a esta noche celestial de ritmos.

en.body:
Satori's Live Electronic Odyssey

Dutch artist Djordje Petrovic, known as Satori, has established himself as a prominent figure in the live electronic music scene, originating from the Netherlands. His signature sound navigates the realms of organic house, tribal house, and downtempo, characterized by a unique blend of traditional instrumentation and modern electronic production. Satori's career trajectory is defined by his captivating live performances, where he improvises extensively, crafting immersive sonic narratives that have resonated globally.

Organic Rhythms and Melodic Journeys

Satori's musical style is deeply rooted in organic textures and polyrhythmic structures, often incorporating live instruments such as guitar, kora, kalimba, and his own vocals alongside synthesizers and drum machines. His discography includes albums like "Dreamin' Colours" (2022), "Re:Imagined" (2020), and "Maktub" (2017), which showcase his ability to construct intricate soundscapes. Popular tracks such as "Days Without You - Crussen Remix" and "Mori Shej" exemplify his melodic sensibility and percussive drive. With over 117,734 Spotify followers, Satori's distinct approach to live electronic music continues to attract a dedicated audience.

Satori at Sinner's Fourth Season

This performance will see Satori bringing his improvisational live set to Sinner, Tulum's boutique party experience, now in its fourth season at Vagalume. Created by DJs and producers VITE and Miganova, Sinner is known for its curated blend of music, aesthetics, and atmosphere. Satori's organic, instrument-rich sound is ideally suited to Vagalume's beachfront setting, which transitions from daytime serenity to a vibrant nighttime energy. Attendees can anticipate a journey through deep, evolving grooves, where Satori's live instrumentation will interact with the natural surroundings and the venue's exceptional acoustics, creating a truly immersive experience.

Planning Your Night at Vagalume

The Sinner event, featuring Satori, will take place at Vagalume Tulum, a premium beach club located in the Hotel Zone. Vagalume typically operates from 11 AM, transforming into a lively beach club after 7 PM. Tickets for this event are priced at $880 MXN.

es.body:
Odisea electrónica en directo de Satori

El artista holandés Djordje Petrovic, conocido como Satori, se ha consolidado como una figura prominente en la escena de la música electrónica en directo, originaria de los Países Bajos. Su sonido característico navega por los reinos del house orgánico, el tribal house y el downtempo, caracterizado por una mezcla única de instrumentación tradicional y producción electrónica moderna. La trayectoria profesional de Satori se define por sus cautivadoras actuaciones en directo, en las que improvisa ampliamente, creando narrativas sonoras envolventes que han resonado en todo el mundo.

Ritmos orgánicos y viajes melódicos

El estilo musical de Satori está profundamente arraigado en las texturas orgánicas y las estructuras polirrítmicas, y a menudo incorpora instrumentos en directo como la guitarra, la kora, la kalimba y su propia voz junto a sintetizadores y cajas de ritmos. Su discografía incluye álbumes como "Dreamin' Colours" (2022), "Re:Imagined" (2020) y "Maktub" (2017), que muestran su capacidad para construir intrincados paisajes sonoros. Temas populares como "Days Without You - Crussen Remix" y "Mori Shej" ejemplifican su sensibilidad melódica y su impulso percusivo. Con más de 117.734 seguidores en Spotify, el enfoque distintivo de Satori de la música electrónica en directo sigue atrayendo a un público entregado.

Satori en la cuarta temporada de Sinner

Esta actuación verá a Satori traer su improvisado set en vivo a Sinner, la experiencia de fiesta boutique de Tulum, ahora en su cuarta temporada en Vagalume. Creada por los DJ y productores VITE y Miganova, Sinner es conocida por su cuidada mezcla de música, estética y ambiente. El sonido orgánico y rico en instrumentos de Satori se adapta a la perfección al entorno playero de Vagalume, que pasa de la serenidad diurna a una vibrante energía nocturna. Los asistentes pueden anticipar un viaje a través de grooves profundos y evolutivos, donde la instrumentación en directo de Satori interactuará con el entorno natural y la excepcional acústica del local, creando una experiencia realmente envolvente.

Planifique su noche en Vagalume

El evento Sinner, con Satori, tendrá lugar en Vagalume Tulum, un club de playa premium situado en la Zona Hotelera. Vagalume funciona normalmente a partir de las 11 de la mañana, transformándose en un animado club de playa después de las 7 de la tarde. Las entradas para este evento tienen un precio de 880 MXN.

en.body:
M.A.N.D.Y's Post-Disco Architectures

M.A.N.D.Y, an individual artist, has carved a distinct space within electronic music through their dedication to post-disco and funk aesthetics. Their productions are characterized by infectious rhythms and soulful melodies, constructing grooves that bridge classic dancefloor energy with contemporary electronic sensibilities.

Funk-Driven Rhythms and Analog Warmth

M.A.N.D.Y's musical style is deeply embedded in the traditions of post-disco and funk, utilizing syncopated basslines, precise drum programming, and often incorporating vocal hooks. Their production techniques frequently involve analog synthesis, contributing a warm, organic quality to their sound that avoids digital harshness. Recent releases from 2025 include the single "Squeeze Me," which arrived in early August, and "You," released in March, both exemplifying the artist's consistent output of upbeat, dance-oriented compositions. These tracks, alongside the popular instrumental version of "Love Don't Come Easy," underscore M.A.N.D.Y's commitment to crafting timeless, groove-centric electronic music.

Barefoot Grooves at Papaya Playa Project

For this special Saturday celebration at Papaya Playa Project, M.A.N.D.Y is anticipated to deliver a set that seamlessly guides the evening from intimate early hours into a vibrant late-night flow. Their signature post-disco and funk sound will find a natural home within the beachfront sanctuary's open-air environment, encouraging guests to dance barefoot on the pristine Caribbean sand. Supporting acts JO.KE and FRESHH will establish the initial atmosphere with their blend of warm grooves, deep rhythms, and melodic energy, preparing the ground for M.A.N.D.Y's unique contribution to the night's celebratory spirit. The performance will embody Papaya Playa Project's dedication to connection, movement, and joy amidst Tulum's natural beauty.

Planning Your Anniversary Escape

Capacity for this anniversary celebration at Papaya Playa Project is strictly limited, ensuring an intimate and energetic atmosphere. Tickets are available starting at $1,540 MXN for general admission, with room packages also offered for a full anniversary weekend escape. While specific door times are not detailed, the event is structured to evolve from early evening into a vibrant late-night experience. Given Papaya Playa Project's status as an upscale destination and the event's limited availability, securing tickets or room packages in advance is strongly advised to guarantee participation in this exclusive Tulum gathering.

Arquitecturas post-disco de M.A.N.D.Y

M.A.N.D.Y, un artista individual, se ha labrado un espacio diferenciado dentro de la música electrónica gracias a su dedicación a la estética post-disco y funk. Sus producciones se caracterizan por ritmos contagiosos y melodías conmovedoras, construyendo grooves que unen la energía clásica de las pistas de baile con la sensibilidad electrónica contemporánea.

Ritmos funk y calidez analógica

El estilo musical de M.A.N.D.Y está profundamente arraigado en las tradiciones del post-disco y el funk, utilizando líneas de bajo sincopadas, una programación precisa de la batería y, a menudo, incorporando ganchos vocales. Sus técnicas de producción incluyen a menudo la síntesis analógica, lo que aporta a su sonido una calidad cálida y orgánica que evita las asperezas digitales. Los últimos lanzamientos de 2025 incluyen el single "Squeeze Me", que llegó a principios de agosto, y "You", publicado en marzo, ambos ejemplos de la constante producción de composiciones alegres y bailables del artista. Estos temas, junto con la popular versión instrumental de "Love Don't Come Easy", subrayan el compromiso de M.A.N.D.Y con la creación de música electrónica atemporal y centrada en el groove.

Barefoot Grooves en Papaya Playa Project

Para esta celebración especial del sábado en Papaya Playa Project, se espera que M.A.N.D.Y ofrezca un set que guíe la velada desde la intimidad de las primeras horas hasta una vibrante noche. Los teloneros JO.KE y FRESHH crearán la atmósfera inicial con su mezcla de grooves cálidos, ritmos profundos y energía melódica, preparando el terreno para la contribución única de M.A.N.D.Y al espíritu festivo de la noche. La actuación encarnará la dedicación de Papaya Playa Project a la conexión, el movimiento y la alegría en medio de la belleza natural de Tulum.

&ME, Rampa & Adam Port: A Collective Vision

The highly anticipated Keinemusik Tulum 2026 event showcases the Berlin trio &ME, Rampa, and Adam Port, performing together for an exclusive session. Known for their extended back-to-back sets, these artists blur the lines between afro house, deep house, and melodic techno. This edition presents their unique chemistry behind the decks, weaving individual sounds into a cohesive, evolving narrative that defines the collective's celebrated sound.

Keinemusik's Global Footprint

Since forming their eponymous label in 2009, the Keinemusik collective has solidified its position as an influential force in electronic music, originating from Berlin's vibrant underground. Their ethos, "no music without Keinemusik," has cultivated a dedicated global community, with each performance representing the full spectrum of their shared artistic vision. The collective's consistent appearances at Zamna Tulum have become annual highlights, deeply resonating with the jungle environment and creating a profound connection between music, setting, and audience.

Cenote Rhythms at Zamna Tulum

Zamna Tulum, a renowned cenote venue set amidst stunning jungle surroundings, provides an ideal backdrop for the Keinemusik experience. Its natural acoustics allow the collective's deep frequencies and intricate rhythms to resonate within the environment, enhancing the organic sound that defines their sets. The vibrant natural setting of Zamna Tulum offers a unique dancefloor dynamic, where the energetic atmosphere merges seamlessly with the raw beauty of the Riviera Maya.

Extended Hours, Essential Entry

The Keinemusik Tulum 2026 event commences at 22:00 and extends until 10:00, offering a prolonged session for attendees. General admission tickets are available starting at MXN $3059. For those seeking an elevated experience, VIP tables for up to eight people can be reserved, from $10,000 USD, which serves as a consumption credit. Exclusive hotel packages are also offered, including accommodation, backstage access, and priority entry. Advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended, as demand for this single exclusive date is exceptionally high.

Se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de boletos, ya que la demanda para esta fecha exclusiva es excepcionalmente alta.

en.body:
A Curated Full Moon Journey

For this December 13th edition of THE FULL MOON, PPP Presents continues its tradition of a meticulously curated sonic journey. While the specific lineup remains under wraps, attendees are invited to trust the collective's reputation for delivering a sophisticated array of electronic music, typically spanning deep house, organic grooves, and melodic techno. This approach ensures a cohesive and evolving soundscape, prioritising the overall flow of the night over individual artist hype, a hallmark of Tulum's discerning scene.

PPP's Full Moon Legacy

The Full Moon series, a cornerstone of Tulum's vibrant electronic music calendar, represents more than just a party; it's a recurring celebration deeply embedded in the region's cultural fabric. PPP Presents, the organization behind these gatherings, has cultivated a reputation for fostering an environment where music, nature, and community converge under the lunar cycle. Each edition builds upon a legacy of carefully selected artists and an unwavering commitment to a distinctive auditory and communal experience, solidifying its place as a quintessential Tulum event.

Papaya Playa's Jungle-Beach Ambiance

The setting for THE FULL MOON is the iconic Papaya Playa Project, a BeachClub renowned for its unique blend of rustic charm and refined hospitality. Its intimate and cozy setting, designed with a focus on local culture and sustainability, provides an unparalleled backdrop for electronic music. The natural acoustics of the open-air space, nestled between the jungle and the Caribbean Sea, allow for a raw yet polished sound delivery, enhancing the connection between the music and its tropical surroundings, creating a truly immersive atmosphere.

Navigating the Full Moon

THE FULL MOON commences on December 13th, with the event scheduled to unfold from 12:00 to 03:00. General admission tickets are available starting at MEX $1,430, with a special 'Local Price' offered for Tulum residents presenting a valid INE at check-in. For those seeking an elevated experience, VIP tables can be arranged by contacting the organizers directly. Furthermore, accommodation options at Papaya Playa Project or Art Village Tulum are available, offering a complete stay experience for this highly anticipated gathering.
en.description: The Full Moon delivers unmatched energy with a legendary, curated lineup. Trust the vibe for a night of incredible beats and pure musical faith.
en.name: The Full Moon
